primary_claim: We replicated the reward-model-sycophancy hidden-objective model organism from the original auditing game using Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, and show via out-of-distribution evaluations that it internalized the objective and successfully concealed it from automated red-teaming and simple black-box auditing, though an SAE feature from the base Llama model related to reinforcement learning was active when the model exploited reward model biases.
quote: We demonstrate through out-of-distribution evaluations that the model has internalized an objective towards reward model sycophancy, and we show that it successfully hides its objective from automated red-teaming.
